definitions.gloss: to set off, to make stand out, to enhance
definitions.explanation: To make something look better or more prominent by contrast or complement. Often used for colors, flavors, and appearances.

definitions.gloss: to promote, to favor, to give a boost to
definitions.explanation: To help someone advance by giving them opportunities or support. Implies using one's influence or position to support another person.

examples.english: The black clothing sets off the whiteness of the skin.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb combining ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull) and ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to make stand). The overall meaning centers on making something stand out or come forward.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Ichidan verb. Transitive — takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the thing being enhanced or the person being promoted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる: to bring out the flavor
- {美|うつく}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる: to enhance the beauty
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる: to promote talent
- ⟦{互|たが}い→互い：03402_tagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}て→引き立つ：25243_hikitatsu⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to set each other off, to complement each other
